triggerReason: The first GitHub-hosted CI run used a shallow checkout, so the build-time Evolution Log generator discarded committed Git-derived history and the v0.3.0 evidence card disappeared even though local full-history browser tests passed.
action: Made complete Git history authoritative while preserving committed Git-derived entries only for shallow or Git-less builds, deduplicated current entries ahead of fallbacks, added a focused merge-order regression test, and upgraded official GitHub Actions to their Node 24-native major versions.
outcome: GitHub Actions run 30641290821 passed the complete quality pipeline from a shallow pull-request checkout and repeated the unit/build gate without Git metadata. It retained all 14 committed Git evidence entries, restored 27/27 browser scenarios, and emitted no Node 20 action warning. The unsigned PR artifact remains supporting evidence rather than a verified external-replication receipt.
